subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The woman ___ teaches accountancy has joined the selection board.
explanation: Who refers to the woman and is the subject of teaches. Whom is an object form.
explanation_pa: 'Who' ਉਸ ਔਰਤ ਵੱਲ ਸੰਕੇਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'teaches' ਦਾ subject ਹੈ। 'Whom' object form ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: When one makes a promise, one should keep ___ word.
explanation: The possessive form of the pronoun one is one's. Ones without an apostrophe does not express possession.
explanation_pa: pronoun 'one' ਦਾ possessive form 'one's' ਹੈ। apostrophe ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ 'ones' ਮਾਲਕੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The author and the publisher signed a joint declaration, ___ has now been released publicly.
explanation: Which introduces a non-defining clause referring to the declaration. That is not used after the comma to introduce this kind of relative clause.
explanation_pa: 'Which' declaration ਬਾਰੇ ਦੱਸਣ ਵਾਲੀ non-defining clause ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। comma ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਇਸ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੀ relative clause ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ 'that' ਨਹੀਂ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: The vehicle belongs to the person who manages the branch. It is the ___ vehicle.
explanation: In a group genitive, the possessive ending can attach to the end of the entire phrase identifying the owner. Person's who manages the branch breaks the noun phrase by placing the possessive ending before its defining clause.
explanation_pa: group genitive ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਦਰਸਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਅੰਤ ਮਾਲਕ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਦੱਸਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ phrase ਦੇ ਅਖ਼ੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਗ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Person's who manages the branch' ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਅੰਤ defining clause ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਲਾਉਣ ਨਾਲ noun phrase ਟੁੱਟ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The cashier handed the refund to ___.
explanation: To requires an objective pronoun, so us is correct. We is used as a subject.
explanation_pa: 'To' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ objective pronoun ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'us' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ। 'We' subject ਵਜੋਂ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The rescue workers congratulated ___ on completing the operation safely.
explanation: The plural reflexive pronoun referring to the workers is themselves. Theirselves is not the standard form.
explanation_pa: workers ਲਈ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲਾ plural reflexive pronoun 'themselves' ਹੈ। 'Theirselves' standard form ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The registrar will appoint ___ the governing body recommends.
explanation: Whomever is the object of recommends within the clause. Whoever would be required if the pronoun were performing the recommending.
explanation_pa: clause ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ 'whomever', 'recommends' ਦਾ object ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਉਹ pronoun ਹੁੰਦਾ, ਤਾਂ 'whoever' ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: The laboratory conducted two independent ___ of the water sample.
explanation: Analyses is the plural of analysis. Analysis is singular and cannot follow two in this context.
explanation_pa: 'Analysis' ਦਾ plural 'analyses' ਹੈ। 'Analysis' singular ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਸੰਦਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ 'two' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਆ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct replacement for 'an information': The help desk gave me an information about the venue.
explanation: Information is uncountable, so an individual item is a piece of information. An information incorrectly treats the noun as countable.
explanation_pa: 'Information' uncountable ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਗੱਲ ਲਈ 'a piece of information' ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'An information' ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸ noun ਨੂੰ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ countable ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Which pair identifies a proper noun followed by a common noun in 'Amritsar attracts tourists throughout the year'?
explanation: Amritsar names a particular city, whereas tourists names a general class of people. Throughout is a preposition, not a common noun.
explanation_pa: 'Amritsar' ਇੱਕ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ 'tourists' ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਆਮ ਵਰਗ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੈ। 'Throughout' preposition ਹੈ, common noun ਨਹੀਂ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The delegation members exchanged notes with one ___ before entering the chamber.
explanation: One another expresses reciprocal interaction among the members. The possessive another's cannot function as the object required here without an appropriate possessed noun.
explanation_pa: 'One another' ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਇੱਕ-ਦੂਜੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। possessive form 'another's' ਨਾਲ ਮਾਲਕੀ ਵਾਲੀ ਚੀਜ਼ ਦੱਸਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਢੁਕਵਾਂ noun ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਇੱਥੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ object ਵਜੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: Only one of the five pumps has lost ___ protective cover.
explanation: One is the singular antecedent, so its refers to the single affected pump. Their would incorrectly connect the missing cover to the plural pumps.
explanation_pa: 'One' singular antecedent ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'its' ਉਸ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਿਤ pump ਵੱਲ ਸੰਕੇਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Their' ਵਰਤਣ ਨਾਲ ਗੁੰਮ ਹੋਏ cover ਦਾ ਸੰਬੰਧ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ plural 'pumps' ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correctly punctuated expression for a hospital intended for children.
explanation: Children is an irregular plural without a final s and takes apostrophe-s. Childrens' incorrectly adds an extra s before forming the possessive.
explanation_pa: 'Children' ਇੱਕ irregular plural ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਅਖ਼ੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ 's' ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ apostrophe-s ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Childrens'' ਵਿੱਚ possessive ਬਣਾਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਧੂ 's' ਜੋੜਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The official from ___ we obtained permission has been transferred.
explanation: Whom is required directly after the preposition from in formal written English. That cannot follow a fronted preposition.
explanation_pa: formal written English ਵਿੱਚ preposition 'from' ਦੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਬਾਅਦ 'whom' ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। ਅੱਗੇ ਲਿਆਂਦੀ ਗਈ preposition ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ 'that' ਨਹੀਂ ਆ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The clerk and ___ have already checked the attendance register.
explanation: The coordinated phrase is the subject of have checked, so I is required. Me is an object pronoun.
explanation_pa: coordinated phrase, 'have checked' ਦਾ subject ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'I' ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Me' object pronoun ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: Neither of the two passwords works; ___ must be replaced with a valid one.
explanation: It serves as the singular subject referring distributively to either invalid password. Them is an object form and cannot be the subject of must be replaced.
explanation_pa: 'It' singular subject ਹੈ ਜੋ ਦੋਵੇਂ invalid passwords ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਇੱਕ ਵੱਲ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਸੰਕੇਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Them' object form ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'must be replaced' ਦਾ subject ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The chicks followed the ___ across the courtyard.
explanation: Hen is the standard female counterpart of rooster. Roosteress is not a standard English word.
explanation_pa: 'Rooster' ਦੇ ਮੁਕਾਬਲੇ ਮਾਦਾ ਲਈ standard ਸ਼ਬਦ 'hen' ਹੈ। 'Roosteress' standard English ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: The traveller bought two ___ containing detailed maps.
explanation: Guidebook is a compound noun whose plural ending attaches to the final element: guidebooks. Guidesbooks incorrectly pluralises both elements.
explanation_pa: 'Guidebook' ਇੱਕ compound noun ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ plural ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਅਖ਼ੀਰਲੇ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'guidebooks' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ। 'Guidesbooks' ਵਿੱਚ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ plural ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct completion: The badge belongs to the commander-in-chief. It is the ___ badge.
explanation: The possessive ending attaches to the end of the complete singular compound: commander-in-chief's. Commander’s-in-chief incorrectly places it inside the compound.
explanation_pa: possessive ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਪੂਰੇ singular compound ਦੇ ਅਖ਼ੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'commander-in-chief's' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ। 'Commander’s-in-chief' ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ compound ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਲਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the sentence that correctly means 'I submitted more applications than she submitted.'
options: I submitted more applications than her did.
I submitted more applications than she did.
I submitted more applications than hers did.
I submitted more applications than herself did.
explanation: She is the subject of the explicit verb did in the comparative clause. Her cannot serve as that subject.
explanation_pa: comparative clause ਵਿੱਚ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਮੌਜੂਦ verb 'did' ਦਾ subject 'she' ਹੈ। 'Her' ਉਸ subject ਵਜੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: Please send the confidential attachment directly to the director or ___.
explanation: The pronoun is governed by to and must take the objective form me. Myself lacks a matching first-person subject and is not a formal substitute for me.
explanation_pa: pronoun ਦਾ ਰੂਪ 'to' ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ, ਇਸ ਲਈ objective form 'me' ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Myself' ਨਾਲ ਮੇਲ ਖਾਂਦਾ first-person subject ਮੌਜੂਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ 'me' ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲਾ formal ਰੂਪ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the sentence in which 'experience' is used as a countable noun.
options: The trek gave her several unforgettable experiences.
The post requires considerable administrative experience.
He gained experience by working in rural branches.
Practical experience improves a technician's judgement.
explanation: Experiences means separate events that a person undergoes and is countable. Experience meaning accumulated knowledge or skill is uncountable.
explanation_pa: 'Experiences' ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਵਾਪਰੀਆਂ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਘਟਨਾਵਾਂ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ countable ਹੈ। ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਂ ਹੁਨਰ ਦੇ ਅਰਥ ਵਿੱਚ 'experience' uncountable ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: In 'Patience helped the trainee handle repeated complaints', 'Patience' is a:
explanation: Patience names a quality and is an abstract noun. Its capital letter at the beginning of the sentence does not make it a proper noun.
explanation_pa: 'Patience' ਇੱਕ ਗੁਣ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ abstract noun ਹੈ। sentence ਦੇ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਅੱਖਰ capital ਹੋਣ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ proper noun ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: The two neighbours borrowed each ___ gardening tools.
explanation: The reciprocal expression each other forms its possessive as each other's. Each others' wrongly treats other as a plural noun here.
explanation_pa: reciprocal expression 'each other' ਦਾ possessive form 'each other's' ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Each others'' ਵਿੱਚ 'other' ਨੂੰ ਇੱਥੇ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ plural noun ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Complete the sentence: Several ___ were grazing beyond the railway crossing.
explanation: Oxen is the irregular plural of ox. Oxens incorrectly adds another plural ending.
explanation_pa: 'Ox' ਦਾ irregular plural 'oxen' ਹੈ। 'Oxens' ਵਿੱਚ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ plural ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਅੰਤ ਜੋੜਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
